level.setting: A derelict corporate data vault beneath Neo-Tokyo, filled with flickering holograms, leaking coolant, and the hum of failing AI systems. Rain streaks the windows as the player navigates through a maze of server racks and security drones.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling tiles and a flickering emergency light that reveals a hidden path to the server room.

pickup.name: EMP Charge
pickup.effect: Disables electronic systems for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Enforcer, the player must use the EMP Charge to disable a security panel, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

encounters.hazard: A field of tripwires connected to explosive charges; the player must navigate carefully to avoid triggering them.

pickup.name: Hacking Module
pickup.effect: Bypasses 1 cybernetic security system

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel-7 unlocks a terminal. The player uses the Hacking Module to disable the vault’s outer defenses, exposing the boss chamber.

encounters.hazard: A constantly shifting maze of laser grids and holographic decoys.

pickup.name: Neural Override Code
pickup.effect: Instantly disables the boss for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: The boss activates a countdown to destroy the vault. The player must use the Hacking Module during the boss fight to trigger the Neural Override Code, creating a window to deliver the final blow.

boss.name: Cybernetic Overmind
boss.victory_condition: Use the Hacking Module to trigger the Neural Override Code, then attack during the 5-second window.

level.objective: Sabotage the vault’s core to prevent a corporate data leak.
level.reward: Data Chip containing a blueprint for a prototype cybernetic upgrade

level.setting: Neon-drenched underground server farm beneath Neo-Kowloon, with unstable power grids and collapsing infrastructure. Rain floods the corridors, and holographic ads flicker erratically.

encounters.hazard: Falling debris triggers if the player takes more than 30 seconds to defeat the enforcer.

pickup.name: Neuro-Virus Chip
pickup.effect: Disables AI-based enemies for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the enforcer triggers a security lockdown, unlocking the sealed server chamber and summoning the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Explosive coolant tanks rupture when the player's health drops below 50%.

pickup.name: Neural Disruptor
pickup.effect: Overloads enemy cybernetics for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone swarm destabilizes the server room's force field, exposing the final encounter with the boss.

encounters.hazard: The boss periodically summons turrets that fire laser grids across the room.

pickup.name: Quantum Keycard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the exit to the next level

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Neural Disruptor during the boss's shield phase (180 seconds into the fight) to bypass its defenses.

boss.name: Nexus Prime
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the central core while avoiding the boss's data storm attacks.

level.objective: Infiltrate the server farm, destroy the rogue AI, and escape with the Quantum Keycard.
level.reward: Unlock the ability to hack enemy drones for 30 seconds

level.setting: Neon Veil - A derelict tech facility in the heart of a neon-soaked cyberpunk metropolis. The air crackles with static, flickering holograms project cryptic warnings, and the hum of old machines echoes through decaying corridors.

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and unstable power surges cause temporary blindness (15% chance per step).

pickup.name: EMP Battery
pickup.effect: One-time use: Overloads electronic enemies, dealing 50 damage

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Warden, a hidden data chip is found on the console, displaying coordinates to the 'Server Room'

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with tripwires linked to turrets; triggering them reduces player health by 20.

pickup.name: Hacking Tool
pickup.effect: Allows bypassing of enemy defenses for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the AI, a data core is found on the mainframe, revealing a hidden maintenance tunnel leading to the 'Bio-Lab'

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas leaks (reduces movement speed by 30% unless player has a gas mask, which is found here).

pickup.name: Thermal Module
pickup.effect: One-time use: Deals 70 fire damage to a single target

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Hunter, a terminal in the lab displays a cryptic message: 'The Overlord sleeps in the Heart of the Machine.' This leads to the final chamber.

boss.name: Cybernetic Overlord
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Overlord by exploiting its thermal vulnerability, destroying the core with the Thermal Module.

level.objective: Navigate the facility, uncover its secrets, and destroy the Cybernetic Overlord using pickups acquired through encounters.
level.reward: Neural Implant Upgrade (increases player weapon damage by 20%)

level.theme: Neon-drenched derelict tech facility with flickering holograms and rain-slicked metal
level.setting: Lower levels of a ruined megacorp server complex, patrolled by rogue AI and cyborg enforcers

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon signs cast unstable light, revealing hidden security drones when the player's blade disrupts time

pickup.name: Time Crystal (Stabilized)
pickup.effect: Increases player's temporal blade damage by 50% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone's core with the Temporal Blade causes the room's time field to destabilize, unlocking a corridor leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Leaking coolant pools create slippery zones; the enforcer's cybernetic arm fires corrosive rounds

pickup.name: Chrono Core (Overclocked)
pickup.effect: Allows the player to briefly freeze time for 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: The Time Crystal's energy reacts with the enforcer's malfunctioning AI, causing it to overheat and reveal a hidden power conduit leading to the boss arena.

encounters.hazard: The boss warps reality, creating temporal rifts that spawn duplicate enemies unless the Chrono Core is activated

pickup.name: Chrono Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks all time-locked doors in the facility

encounters.trigger: The Chrono Core's energy destabilizes the Sentinel's time-loop programming, allowing the player to exploit its core vulnerability during the fight.

boss.name: The Sentinel (Time-Locked AI)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Sentinel's central core while time is frozen using the Chrono Core

level.objective: Reach the mainframe core and disable the rogue AI by exploiting temporal vulnerabilities
level.reward: Chrono Key granting access to restricted time-manipulation tech

encounters.hazard: Falling debris triggers if the drone is not disabled quickly.

pickup.name: Nanobiotic Catalyst
pickup.effect: Boosts alchemical potency by 30% for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the drone unlocks a hidden lab corridor via a malfunctioning security panel.

encounters.location: Alchemical Research Wing - Overgrown with Bioluminescent Fungi
encounters.hazard: Toxic gas leaks activate if the dealer is not subdued within 60 seconds.

pickup.name: Toxic Syringe
pickup.effect: Injects a debuff reducing enemy armor by 40% for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Using the Nanobiotic Catalyst on the dealer reveals a hidden stash containing the Toxic Syringe.

encounters.location: Mutant Holding Cells - Soundproofed with Cracked Glass
encounters.hazard: The hybrid's mutations cause random area-of-effect damage when aggroed.

pickup.name: Quantum Alchemical Core
pickup.effect: Temporarily upgrades the Vial Launcher to deal 50% more damage.

encounters.trigger: Injecting the hybrid with the Toxic Syringe weakens its mutations, revealing a sealed vault containing the Quantum Alchemical Core.

boss.name: The Architect (Rogue AI)
boss.victory_condition: Combine the Quantum Alchemical Core with the player's weapon to trigger a chain reaction that destabilizes the AI's core.

level.objective: Retrieve the Alchemical Formula from the lab's central server, but beware of the rogue AI's defenses.
level.reward: Alchemical Formula: 'Neuro-Disruptive Elixir' (Instantly incapacitates enemies with 100% accuracy for 5 seconds).

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon lights reveal hidden enemy patrol routes.

pickup.name: Neural Dampener
pickup.effect: Disrupts enemy cybernetics, reducing their damage by 40% for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Hack a terminal to unlock the vault, triggering the enforcer's alert.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling panels force narrow, stealth-based navigation.

pickup.name: Viral Payload
pickup.effect: Corrupts enemy AI systems, dealing 200 damage over 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Use Neural Dampener to bypass a security drone, revealing the cyborg guard's patrol path.

encounters.hazard: The AI manipulates environmental hazards (e.g., electrified pools, falling debris).

pickup.name: System Override Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks all city grid terminals (non-combat use)

encounters.trigger: Trigger a lockdown sequence after defeating the cyborg guard, forcing a confrontation with the AI Core.

boss.name: The Architect
boss.victory_condition: Corrupt the AI's core with the payload while avoiding its hacking attempts.

level.objective: Infiltrate the server nexus and destroy the AI Core, using pickups to overcome escalating defenses.
level.reward: System Override Key unlocks access to the city's neural grid, providing future mission options.

level.setting: A neon-drenched cityscape with floating platforms, glitchy holograms, and eccentric AI chatter. Rain falls in sync with the player's lightning strikes.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Whip (Electricity-based, deals 5 damage per strike)

encounters.hazard: Glitching holograms create temporary barriers; player must time strikes between flashes.

pickup.name: Nano-Circuit Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases Plasma Whip damage by 2 for the next 3 encounters.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Drone-5 unlocks a floating keycard that activates the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: AI projects confusing riddles; solving them (by attacking in rhythm) reduces enemy damage.

pickup.name: Quantum Sprocket
pickup.effect: Allows player to temporarily summon a lightning shield (blocks 15 damage).

encounters.trigger: Destroying Gigglesoft-7 triggers a hidden door leading to the boss arena.

encounters.hazard: Boss summons duplicate drones that must be prioritized; player's shield (from Quantum Sprocket) is essential.

pickup.name: Stormcaller's Crown
pickup.effect: Unlocks a final lightning burst ability (one-time use, 20 damage).

encounters.trigger: Boss fight begins automatically after unlocking the door from the second encounter.

boss.name: The Glitch King (Floating Cyborg Tyrant)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the capacitor's enhanced damage, then claim the Stormcaller's Crown.

level.objective: Navigate the whimsical cyberpunk city, defeat three eccentric enemies, and claim the Stormcaller's Crown to unlock a new ability.
level.reward: Stormcaller's Crown (One-time use lightning burst) + 20 XP

level.setting: Neon Bloom - A serene rooftop garden in a cyberpunk city, where bioluminescent plants glow under neon lights and rain-slicked surfaces reflect the distant hum of the metropolis. The area is quiet, almost meditative, but hidden dangers lurk beneath the calm.

encounters.hazard: The Sentinel patrols near a cluster of glowing ferns. Its mechanical limbs are brittle from years of neglect.

pickup.name: Geothermal Core
pickup.effect: Increases geomancy damage by 25% and enables fire-based earth manipulation.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel causes a hidden hatch to open, revealing a tunnel leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: The tunnel is lined with glowing fungi. Rootfang's mutated body is entwined with plant matter, making it unpredictable.

pickup.name: Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Creates vibrational waves that disrupt electronics and shatter brittle materials.

encounters.trigger: Destroying Rootfang triggers a holographic map on the wall, pointing to the data center where the third encounter lies.

encounters.hazard: Cipher's body is a mesh of wires and circuitry. It emits electromagnetic pulses that disrupt the player's abilities.

pickup.name: Access Code
pickup.effect: Unlocks the central control room's security system, allowing passage to the final boss.

encounters.trigger: Disrupting Cipher's systems reveals a hidden elevator leading to the boss arena.

boss.name: The Core Sentinel
boss.victory_condition: Overload the Sentinel's core by channeling resonance waves through the environment, causing structural collapse.

level.objective: Navigate the serene rooftop garden, defeat three hidden threats, and use their pickups to dismantle the final boss guarding the city's data core.
level.reward: Neural Implant - Enhances geomancy abilities with a 10% chance to trigger random terrain effects.
